day_shape: 41 items dominated by regime-channel coverage of a 'martyred leader' funeral build-up and IRGC Strait of Hormuz readiness claims, alongside Israeli press reports of anti-Hamas protests in Gaza and Iran Foreign Ministry ceasefire-violation claims; nothing from UK Parliament, State Dept or OFAC.

threads.label: Funeral preparations for 'martyred leader'
threads.summary: Regime channels said a national headquarters has been formed for the funeral of the 'revolution's martyred leader', with 1,000 Tehran schools prepared for pilgrims and the first vice president ordering deployment of executive capacities. Police chief Radan and government spokesman Mohajrani framed the procession as a display of national unity, alongside a Khamenei office message on preserving unity.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and ceasefire claims
threads.summary: IRIB quoted the Supreme Leader's IRGC representative saying forces are 'ready for mission' in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz, and reported Iran-Oman consultations on a framework for managing the strait. The Jerusalem Post reported Iran's Foreign Ministry claiming a US strike on Iran and an alleged attack on Lebanon violated the ceasefire.

threads.label: Lebanon-Israel agreement denounced
threads.summary: Defa Press carried Ansarullah Yemen official Mohammad al-Farah calling the Lebanon-Israel agreement 'a coalition to destroy resistance', and Hezbollah parliamentary bloc head Mohammad Raed saying the Lebanese government has come under 'American guardianship'. The outlet framed the deal as transferring the battle into Lebanese territory.

threads.label: Anti-Hamas protests in Gaza
threads.summary: The Times of Israel reported hundreds of Palestinians demonstrating in Gaza on Friday with signs reading 'Hamas out' and 'We want to live'. The Jerusalem Post followed up saying planned anti-Hamas demonstrations were largely suppressed after Hamas deployed armed operatives and imposed movement restrictions.

threads.label: Iran economic and infrastructure strain
threads.summary: IRIB said the Central Bank will allocate $2 billion for industrial sector imports in a first phase, citing 'removal of oil export restrictions', while Tehran's electricity distribution CEO said air conditioners consume 3,500 megawatts. Iran International cited Shargh daily on repeated banking system failures and reported on the limits of direct-to-cell satellite tech against Iran's internet shutdown.

events.title_en: Telephone conversation between Iranian and Venezuelan foreign ministers
events.summary_en: Telephone conversation between Iranian and Venezuelan foreign ministers. In this telephone conversation, Iran's foreign minister expressed the sincere condolences and sympathy of the Iranian nation and government with the people and government of Venezuela, especially the families of those killed in the recent devastating earthquake, and wished the injured in this incident recovery and good health. With endless salutations to the bright soul of the martyred leader and all the honourable martyrs of the recent aggression, we respectfully and honourably commemorate the martyrs of the horrific crime of the chemical bombing of Sardasht, the brave chemical war victims and all the martyrs of the path of dignity, independence and pride of the Islamic Republic of Iran. The 39th anniversary of the burning tragedy of the chemical bombing of the city of Sardasht and the national day of struggle against chemical and biological weapons is being commemorated at a time when history has opened another blood-stained but glorious page of the suffering and resistance of the Iranian nation before the world. Sardasht is not merely a city; it is a symbol of suffering...

events.title_en: Meeting between Iran's ambassador to Georgia and foreign minister
events.summary_en: Meeting between Iran's ambassador to Georgia and foreign minister. Seyyed Ali Mojani, ambassador of the Islamic Republic of Iran in Tbilisi, met and held talks with Seyyed Abbas Araghchi, foreign minister, on Saturday. During this meeting, Iran's ambassador presented a report on the state of bilateral relations, the initiatives and measures taken and programmes underway to develop relations and expand cooperation between the Islamic Republic of Iran and Georgia. The foreign minister, referring to the historical relations and long-standing ties between Iran and Georgia, emphasised the necessity of strengthening cooperation and expanding bilateral interactions and consultations in all areas of interest, within the framework of mutual respect and shared interests.

events.summary_en: Commander Radan: Funeral procession of martyred leader is display of nation's love and affection for their leader. The commander-in-chief of police, referring to the importance of the martyred leader's funeral ceremony, said: This ceremony is not merely a funeral, but rather a manifestation of the power, resilience, unity and people's love for Imam the Martyr and the ideals of the Islamic Revolution. For several decades, the historic funeral of Imam Khomeini (may he rest in peace) has been the subject of global attention, and we are confident that this ceremony will also be recorded in history as one of the most unprecedented funerals. From some neighbouring countries including Afghanistan, Pakistan and Iraq, it has been announced that many people will come to Iran to participate in the funeral ceremony, and in return, a number of fellow citizens will also prepare to attend...

events.summary_en: Formation of national headquarters for funeral of revolution's martyred leader; every home, one mourning hall, Mohajrani, government spokesman. The regular holding of sessions of the committee organising the funeral and farewell ceremony for the revolution's martyred leader and his family was announced, and he said: These sessions are also active in the provinces and the committee is headed by the first vice president with provincial responsibility resting with the governors. The scheme 'Every home a mourning hall and a pilgrim house' will be implemented to make the ceremony more popular so we witness the farewell to our martyred Imam; he who in pursuit of upholding the great name of Iran sacrificed his life for the Islamic Republic of Iran.

events.summary_en: Inspection organisation's programmes became problem-oriented; every inspection must solve a specific problem in society, Khodaian, head of the State Inspection Organisation. Of 214 corruption hotspots identified, 74 have been resolved so far; this means one third of the identified breeding grounds have been eliminated. Provincial inspections ceased to be isolated; now programmes are implemented nationwide; such as the plan to combat tax evasion which all provinces pursue simultaneously. Smart monitoring replaced the traditional method; with the digitisation of organisations, traditional inspection is not effective, so access to systems and electronic monitoring were placed on the agenda. The 136.ir system; an intelligent communication bridge with the people; reports received...

events.summary_en: Maliki meets with Iran's ambassador to Iraq. The head of the Rule of Law coalition, on Saturday, received Mohammad Kazem Ale Sadegh, ambassador of the Islamic Republic of Iran to Iraq, for talks regarding bilateral relations and the latest political and security developments in the region. In this meeting, besides discussion of the latest political and security developments in the region, bilateral relations between Iraq and the Islamic Republic of Iran and ways to strengthen mutual cooperation in a manner that serves the interests of the two neighbouring nations, were reviewed.

events.title_en: Identification of 2,000 corruption breeding grounds; 214 cases prioritised for prevention, Khodaian, head of the State Inspection Organisation
events.summary_en: Identification of 2,000 corruption breeding grounds; 214 cases prioritised for prevention, Khodaian, head of the State Inspection Organisation. Inspection with a preventive approach rather than punitive, from amongst 2,000 identified problems, 214 cases were placed as 'corruption hotspots' on the agenda. Eliminating the breeding ground requires no confrontation; preventive action is both low-cost and has lasting effect, because with the elimination of the environment, corruption does not form by itself. Transparency; a key solution to break the chain of problems; lack of transparency can be the source of many disorders.

events.title: Iran held by Egypt, waits on results in bid for first World Cup knockout place
events.summary: Iran’s official national team missed the chance to qualify automatically for the World Cup knockout stage for the first time in its history after a 1-1 draw with Egypt in Seattle, but can still advance depending on results in other groups.
